name: GetIt
tagline: Send HTTP requests to API endpoints
blurb: GetIt's main focus is to make your life a lot easier when you have to test APIs or use somebody else's API.
description:
GetIt's main focus is to make your life a lot easier when you have to test APIs or use somebody else's API.
We know it can be hard to find a great, simple and open source application for this task that's not command
line based.

You can send numerous requests to a webserver. You can send RAW post data, form post data, add cookies to your
request and add headers to your request.

The response can be viewed either as syntax highlighted code, with JSON even being made readable,
as the raw output, which means no syntax highlighting, and view it in a webview.

Features of GetIt include:

• Sending HTTP requests to API endpoints and display the response of the server

• Saving and opening requests

• Easily open recent saved/opened requests

• Sending custom POST data

• Syntax highlighting for all responses

• Preview for HTML response

• Make JSON response look beautiful automatically

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
